title: Indus Valley Civilization Begins
description: One of the world's earliest urban civilizations emerges in the Indus River basin with advanced city planning and trade.

title: Mature Harappan Phase
description: Major cities like Harappa and Mohenjo-daro flourish with drainage systems standardized weights and long-distance trade.

title: Decline of Indus Civilization
description: Urban centers begin to decline due to environmental and economic changes leading to population dispersal.

title: Vedic Age Begins
description: Indo-Aryan communities settle in northwestern India and compose the earliest Vedic hymns.

title: Later Vedic Period
description: Expansion into the Gangetic plains leads to larger kingdoms agriculture and social transformations.

title: Mahajanapadas Rise
description: Sixteen major states emerge across northern India laying the foundation for future empires.

title: Birth of Gautama Buddha
description: Siddhartha Gautama is born and later becomes the founder of Buddhism.

title: Birth of Mahavira
description: Mahavira the 24th Tirthankara is born and becomes a central figure in Jainism.

title: Rise of Magadha
description: Magadha emerges as the most powerful Mahajanapada under rulers like Bimbisara.

title: Nirvana of Mahavira
description: Mahavira attains liberation and Jainism continues to spread across India.

title: Mahaparinirvana of Buddha
description: Gautama Buddha passes away at Kushinagar leaving behind a major religious tradition.

title: Alexander Invades India
description: Alexander the Great crosses the Indus River and enters northwestern India.

title: Mauryan Empire Founded
description: Chandragupta Maurya defeats the Nanda dynasty and establishes the first major pan-Indian empire.

title: Treaty with Seleucus
description: Chandragupta signs a treaty with Seleucus Nicator expanding Mauryan influence westward.

title: Bindusara Becomes Emperor
description: Bindusara succeeds Chandragupta and expands Mauryan territories further south.

title: Ashoka Ascends Throne
description: Ashoka becomes ruler of the Mauryan Empire and later transforms Indian history.

title: Kalinga War
description: Ashoka conquers Kalinga in a devastating war that leads him to embrace Buddhism.

title: Ashoka's Buddhist Missions
description: Ashoka sends missionaries across Asia helping spread Buddhism internationally.

title: Death of Ashoka
description: The Mauryan Empire begins weakening after the death of its greatest ruler.

title: Shunga Dynasty Founded
description: Pushyamitra Shunga overthrows the last Mauryan ruler and establishes a new dynasty.

title: Kanva Dynasty Established
description: The Kanvas replace the Shungas and continue ruling parts of northern India.

title: Satavahana Expansion
description: The Satavahana dynasty becomes a major power in the Deccan region.

title: Kushan Era Begins
description: The Kushan Empire rises in northwestern India promoting trade and cultural exchange.

title: Reign of Kanishka
description: Kanishka strengthens the Kushan Empire and supports the spread of Buddhism.

title: Gupta Empire Founded
description: Chandragupta I establishes the Gupta Empire beginning India's Golden Age.

title: Samudragupta's Expansion
description: Samudragupta conducts extensive military campaigns and expands Gupta influence.

title: Faxian Visits India
description: The Chinese monk Faxian travels through India documenting society and Buddhism.

title: Aryabhata Publishes Aryabhatiya
description: Aryabhata makes groundbreaking contributions to mathematics and astronomy.

title: Decline of Gupta Empire
description: Huna invasions and regional fragmentation weaken the Gupta Empire.

title: Harsha Becomes Emperor
description: Harshavardhana unifies much of northern India and promotes culture and religion.

title: Xuanzang Visits India
description: The Chinese scholar Xuanzang travels across India documenting its politics and education.

title: Death of Harsha
description: The death of Harsha marks the end of the last major empire of ancient India.

title: Arab Conquest of Sindh
description: Muhammad bin Qasim conquers Sindh introducing Islamic political influence into the subcontinent.

title: Delhi Sultanate Established
description: Qutb-ud-din Aibak founds the Delhi Sultanate beginning centuries of Sultanate rule.

title: Vijayanagara Empire Founded
description: The Vijayanagara Empire emerges as a major Hindu kingdom in South India.

title: First Battle of Panipat
description: Babur defeats Ibrahim Lodi and establishes the Mughal Empire.

title: Akbar Becomes Emperor
description: Akbar begins one of the most influential reigns in Indian history.

title: Aurangzeb's Reign Begins
description: Aurangzeb expands the Mughal Empire to its greatest territorial extent.

title: Shivaji Crowned King
description: Shivaji establishes the Maratha Kingdom and challenges Mughal dominance.

title: Battle of Plassey
description: British East India Company gains decisive control in Bengal.

title: First War of Independence
description: Indian soldiers and civilians revolt against British rule across northern India.

title: Indian National Congress Founded
description: A political platform emerges that later leads the independence movement.

title: Jallianwala Bagh Massacre
description: British troops fire on unarmed civilians in Amritsar shocking the nation.

title: Dandi March
description: Mahatma Gandhi leads the Salt March challenging British colonial laws.

title: Quit India Movement
description: Mass protests demand an immediate end to British rule.

title: Indian Independence
description: India gains freedom from British rule and becomes an independent nation.

title: Republic of India Established
description: The Constitution of India comes into effect creating the world's largest democracy.
